description: Megumi at the culture festival: all of MI_S6.BIN, MI_S6S.BIN, MI_S6W.BIN (544 strings; base 0x801E8000). Verified in DuckStation on forced festival days (tools/emu/force_festival.py, hidden emulator; docs/testing.md 'The culture festival'): her acceptance (S6S). Choosing an exhibit with her returns to the title screen in the unpatched game as well (run fu09b), so her tour (S6W) is unseen; S6 unseen. Layout and flow in game-internals 6ab. The stage shows (Drama play, Band concert, Literature speech contest) are BUNKA_SD.EXN, still Japanese. Natural triggers, other years and moods checked only statically.
